rules.sentence: Diagnosing epithelioid sarcoma can be challenging due to its mixed mesenchymal and epithelial differentiation.

Immunohistochemical labeling may be used to confirm the diagnosis, although it is essential to consider other more common diagnostic entities with similar histologic and immunophenotypic characteristics.

The most accurate diagnosis can be made by considering the appropriate clinical context, such as the presence of a soft tissue mass on the extremity of a young male, with immunohistochemical staining providing diagnostic support.
